runSummary.stalePolicy: Discovery age is not verification age. LIVE requires fresh full-detail/link evidence; list/search resurfacing cannot set verifiedAt.
runSummary.note: Fresh locality-gated sweep covered Profesia, direct-company/public ATS, LinkedIn, Worki, Kariera, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress public ecosystem, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new promotion-grade BA-area or Slovakia-compatible remote opportunity surfaced. Upwork returned concrete WooCommerce work, but current readable hits were stale, low-budget, already hired/high-competition, or expert/hard-development scope. Facebook has 0 verified hits. Existing LIVE jobs remain fail-closed because safe complete jobs-data.json round-trip replacement cannot be guaranteed by the current repository read surface.

developmentChanges.title: Source latency calibration
developmentChanges.reason: Measure how quickly each source family exposes newly published jobs to public indexing and adjust polling/recheck priority accordingly, so slow-indexing sources are not falsely treated as empty while fast sources get tighter freshness windows.

developmentChanges.title: Application packet readiness score
developmentChanges.reason: For each strong candidate, record whether the required CV variant, portfolio proof, salary answer, language text and platform profile are already ready. Prioritize opportunities that can be applied to immediately and surface exactly what is missing for the others.
